Name: Skillglow
Author: ISITongue
Description:
Bring a bit more life to your professions with [b]Profession Auras[/b]!
This mod add visual auras around your character depending on the skills and professions you have unlocked.
Each of the 5 main skills have 2 aura tiers:
[list]
[*]Farming [/*]
[*]Fishing [/*]
[*]Foraging [/*]
[*]Mining [/*]
[*]Combat [/*]
[/list]The first aura unlock at [b]level 5[/b], and the second one at [b]level 10[/b].
But the aura is not just based on the skill level.
The actual appearance also changes depending on the profesion you picked.
For exemple, a level 10 Mining character can have completly different effects depending on his profession:
[b]Blacksmith[/b]
Coal, hot embers and sparks rising around the player.
[b]Prospector[/b]
Gold fragments and little golden sparkles.
[b]Excavator[/b]
Stone and quartz fragments.
[b]Gemologist[/b]
Quartz and iridium particles with a more bright crystal look.
The same idea is used for every profession in Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat.
Most of the particles use actual Stardew Valley sprites like leaves, petals, wood, stone, ores and quartz so the effects stay close to the vanilla game style.
The aura start from a small area around the player's feet, then particles slowly rise around the body and disappear above the head. I tried to keep the effects visible but not too distracting during normal gameplay.
[b]Controls[/b]

"F8"

Enable / disable your currently equipped aura.

"F9"

Open the aura selection menu.
The selected aura and its ON/OFF state are saved with your game.
This mod is currently [b]visual only[/b].
It does not change profession stats or give gameplay bonuses.
Just a little reward for actually becoming good at something instead of your farmer looking exactly the same after 200 hours 😂
